description: Tunable pricing rules for the dynamic pricing engine. Change pricing behaviour by editing data here, not by changing code. day_of_week_multipliers is indexed Mon..Sun (7 values) and gives every weekday a different price (weekend departures higher). lead_time applies an advance-purchase premium: up to +boost for a same-day departure, decaying to 0 at 'days' out. holiday/event multipliers are applied as (1 + boost) and are >= 1 so they never lower the pre-clamp price. elasticity is the default price elasticity of demand for the profit optimiser (a +10% price change moves demand by roughly -elasticity*10%; must be > 1). elasticity_by_segment overrides it per route segment: business travellers are less price-sensitive (lower value) than leisure ones. base_demand_per_seat is the demand at the base fare on an ordinary day as a multiple of the route's seats (>1 means the base fare alone would overfill the aircraft). marginal_cost_ratio is the cost to serve one seat as a fraction of the base fare (0..1). The optimiser maximises profit (price - cost) * min(demand, seats): the unconstrained optimum is the markup cost * e/(e-1); when demand at that price exceeds the seats, price rises to the market-clearing level - peak pricing emerges from capacity, not from a rule. campaign_lead_days is how many days before a demand peak ad campaigns should be live; the advisor uses it to date its recommended actions.
